name: scrollable-card-stack
title: Scrollable Card Stack
description: Deck of video cards stacked front to back, each one behind sitting a little higher, smaller and fainter, with dots underneath for position.

meta.interaction: Scrolling the wheel over the deck, swiping up or down, pressing the arrow keys or clicking a dot advances one card at a time, with the front card giving way as the whole stack shuffles forward a step. Hovering the front card nudges it slightly larger.
